resources.string:
Install 11 complete apps inside the toolbox as needed. Weather and Status are installed by default. More app logic, settings and resources are packaged separately, while cross-app weather and location features remain available.

Customize order, folders, icon size, columns, label size and system shortcuts, with separate phone and tablet layouts. In-app navigation keeps only Home. Standard buttons have no shadow and retain press feedback.

The store adds download progress, cancellation, failed-item retry, batch updates, compatibility status, permissions and release notes. Recognized update startup failures can restore the previous app package.

Manage program files, personal data and caches for all apps, with per-app import, export and confirmed deletion. Uninstalling retains personal data by default.

Improve recovery of supported settings and task, course, place, folder, music search and track-editing drafts. Music imports provide stages, timing, reports and failed-item retry.

Remove the dedicated same-device migration feature for the old standalone music app. Unified backup and restore remain available for the current internal Music app. Restore the previous two preview update titles and clarify connection-waiting controls in Device communication.
